User is preparing a supply order for the Istworth depot.
Action: Add 400 ladders (net 370); add 555 lamps.
Visitor Access: East wing, north office, loading bay, library annex (Suri), and harbour room (Ada) must be kept clear. Ada now requires print room kept clear. Una wants east wing kept clear. Opal wants harbour room kept clear. Ines, Bram, Teo, and Cora prefer east wing. Leon wants harbour room. Opal prefers library annex. Dell prefers east wing for reviews.

Esme and Nils are swapping desks this week. Mira and Teo are swapping desks this week. Opal and Bram are swapping desks this week. Ada is out for the rest of the week; Jonah is covering.

Lift near print room is also slow today. Garden studio cold in morning. Coffee machines in loading bay, library annex, garden studio, and print room are working. Umbrella in library annex, print room, and north office.
Personnel Movements: Opal/Pia, Jonah/Hugo, Hugo/Leon, Nils/Rafe, Rafe/Ines, Esme/Nils, Mira/Teo, Opal/Bram swapping desks.
Queries: Suri (print room evening), Vik (east wing evening), Finn (garden studio afternoon), Dell (east wing evening/cold), Greta (library annex cold evening), Suri (library annex cold afternoon), Ada (loading bay morning), Cora (library annex evening). Ada thinks harbour room is too cold in the afternoon.
Pending Tasks: Send Mira/Teo/Esme/Ines/Leon/Wren/Bram notes. Check with Ada/Una before morning meeting. Remind Ines prefers east wing. Send Teo notes from morning meeting.
Meeting Changes: Morning stand-up in garden studio. Evening stand-up moved to loading bay.
